story:
Why this one matters: Week 1 already has a Super Bowl rematch, an Australia game, a 59-37 in Charlotte, a 31-30 overtime in Detroit, and Giants 28-20 on Sunday night. It does not yet have a Monday night result.

Broncos at Chiefs, Arrowhead Stadium, 8:15 p.m. ET, ESPN and ABC. ESPN's scoreboard still lists both clubs 0-0 with kickoff to come. That is the honest line while Elland Road is live.
